# 30 Minute Meeting fs (Ashley Stirrup)
Date: 2026-08-19 | Duration: 25.709999084472656m

## Summary
Speero and Growth Book discussed potential collaboration to leverage their respective customer bases and marketing efforts. Jonny Longden and Ashley Stirrup emphasized mutual interest in joint account-based marketing strategies and exploring overlapping customers for growth. Event sponsorship and lead generation were highlighted as key avenues, including Speero's international events and Growth Book's eagerness to sponsor. Speero also proposed supporting Growth Book's clients with free consulting to enhance client success and tool adoption. Both companies shared insights on product strategies, with Speero focusing on automation and experimentation, while Growth Book emphasized AI integration. The conversation concluded with plans for co-creating marketing content and regular knowledge-sharing sessions to align efforts.
